bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Acquires 1,109 Bitcoins for $85.4 Million
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. has expanded its corporate Bitcoin treasury by acquiring 1,109 BTC for approximately $85.4 million, bringing its total holdings to 16,500 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Coinbase Announces Listing of Citrea (CTR) Token
bitcoin_articles.summary: Coinbase has announced the upcoming listing of Citrea (CTR), a token associated with a Bitcoin layer-2 scaling solution designed to enhance smart contract functionality.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Updates Treasury Assets to $12.3 Billion
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced that its total treasury assets, including 5.39 million ETH and 203 Bitcoin, have reached $12.3 billion.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Pauses Bitcoin and Ethereum Acquisitions
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies has officially paused its ongoing Bitcoin and Ethereum accumulation strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Smarter Web Company Expands Bitcoin Reserves and Increases Leverage via Coinbase
bitcoin_articles.summary: Smarter Web Company has announced an expansion of its Bitcoin holdings and the utilization of Coinbase infrastructure to increase its leverage.
